title: Crosswalk 99 chapter labels to actual source versions

status_definitions.VERIFIED_SOURCE: A manuscript, edition or source version is named in this repository together with a per-slot locator. No row qualifies at this baseline.
status_definitions.LABEL_ONLY: The label exists only as an entry in the editorial coverage index; no manuscript, edition or source version is named for the slot.
status_definitions.NEEDS_SOURCE: The label exists, and a repository document explicitly records the slot subject or its source family as unrecovered, ambiguous, disputed or rights-unresolved.

assertions: A chapter label is an editorial index entry. It is not a manuscript, an edition, a transcript or an original source version.
The count of 99 labels is a count of editorial slots. It is not a count of 99 manuscripts, 99 originals, 99 recovered chapters or 99 sources.
Zero rows in this crosswalk claim VERIFIED_SOURCE. No per-chapter manuscript or edition is named anywhere in this repository at the baseline SHA.
Slot numbers 1-99 reproduce the editorial coverage index. They are not source identifiers, catalogue numbers or manuscript numbers.

caveats: The pinned ref is recorded as a 16-hex prefix, not a full 40-character commit SHA, and cannot be resolved from this repository.

The pinned path conflicts with docs/vision/MASTER_VISION_NARRATIVE_XV.md:779 and :853, which cite docs/knowledge/narratives/MASTER_NARRATIVE_V10_1_EXPANDED.md at fff3b0dbc452e998f221e2ca15fd1d41e0ffc599.
docs/vision/MASTER_VISION_NARRATIVE_XV.md:971 states V10.1 is a public-safe expansion, not verbatim original; therefore the family pin does not establish a per-chapter source version.
docs/audit/M06-07-source-crosswalk-queue.md:15 classifies the 99-chapter family as Editorial Only.

limitations: No V1-V10 original or V10.1 source file is present in this repository; only the editorial index in MASTER_VISION_NARRATIVE_XV.md section 21.
The external source family is pinned to a truncated ref and a path that disagrees with another in-repo citation, so it was not opened or verified by this task.
NEEDS_SOURCE mappings from an explicit gap note to a slot are editorial (for example 00-MAIN GOD PROMISE to slot 19); the note itself is quoted in gap_evidence.

Adjacent gap evidence not assigned to a slot: XII 15 synopses / 63 reconstructed pages (MASTER_VISION:974), patch #014 numbering (M06-04), and Mahsyar-related slot 86 which is not the separately named MAHSYAR COVENANT slot 84.
